column1: # Which suites a changed path can affect: <zsh glob><TAB><selectors>. scripts/test-select.sh reads
# this table; scripts/test-test-select.sh pins it. A path takes the union of every row it matches,
# and a path no row matches selects `everything`, so a new kind of file errs towards running more.
# `*` crosses `/`, so `*.md` is markdown at any depth and `daemon/*` everything under daemon/.
# Selectors: everything, toolchain, daemon, target:<Target>, suite:<Target>.<Suite>, none
# (`none` is for paths no test reads; it adds nothing, so a path that only matches it runs nothing).
# A row is here because a test reads the path, so the cross-reads are rows too: the wire fixtures
# and the daemon's delivery module are read by Swift suites, the hooks by the status line shim's
# tests, the Info.plist by the release feed's. Keep a new reader in step with its row here.
